verses.kjv: The children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,
verses.modern: Jaala, Darkon, Giddel,

verses.kjv: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Amon.
verses.modern: Shephatiah, Hattil, Pochereth-hazzebaim, and Amon.

verses.kjv: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants, were three hundred ninety and two.
verses.modern: All the temple servants and the descendants of Solomon's servants were 392.

verses.kjv: And these were they which went up also from Telmelah, Telharesha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer: but they could not shew their father's house, nor their seed, whether they were of Israel.
verses.modern: The following came up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer. But they could not prove their ancestral houses or their descent, whether they were from Israel:

verses.kjv: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred forty and two.
verses.modern: the descendants of Delaiah, Tobiah, and Nekoda — 642.

verses.kjv: And of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai, which took one of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite to wife, and was called after their name.
verses.modern: among the priests: the descendants of Hobaiah, Hakkoz, and Barzillai (who had married a daughter of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called by their name).

verses.kjv: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but it was not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.
verses.modern: These searched for their entries in the genealogical records. But they could not be found. They were excluded from the priesthood as unclean.

verses.kjv: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and Thummim.
verses.modern: The governor told them that they should not eat any of the most holy food until there was a priest serving with Urim and Thummim.

verses.kjv: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,
verses.modern: The whole assembly together numbered 42,360,

verses.kjv: Beside their manservants and their maidservants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and they had two hundred forty and five singing men and singing women.
verses.modern: besides their male and female servants, who numbered 7,337. They also had 245 male and female singers.

verses.kjv: Their horses, seven hundred thirty and six: their mules, two hundred forty and five:
verses.modern: Their horses numbered 736, their mules 245,

verses.kjv: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five: six thousand seven hundred and twenty asses.
verses.modern: their camels 435. Their donkeys 6,720.

verses.kjv: And some of the chief of the fathers gave unto the work. The Tirshatha gave to the treasury a thousand drams of gold, fifty basons, five hundred and thirty priests' garments.
verses.modern: Some of the heads of families contributed to the work. The governor gave to the treasury 1,000 gold coins, 50 bowls, and 530 priestly garments.

verses.kjv: And some of the chief of the fathers gave to the treasure of the work twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand and two hundred pound of silver.
verses.modern: Some of the heads of families gave to the treasury for the work 20,000 gold coins and 2,200 pounds of silver.

verses.kjv: And that which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand pound of silver, and threescore and seven priests' garments.
verses.modern: The rest of the people gave 20,000 gold coins, 2,000 pounds of silver, and 67 priestly garments.

verses.kjv: So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and some of the people, and the Nethinims, and all Israel, dwelt in their cities; and when the seventh month came, the children of Israel were in their cities.
verses.modern: The priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, the temple servants, and all Israel settled in their towns. When the seventh month came, the people of Israel were in their towns.

chapters.summary: After the wall was completed, Nehemiah appointed gatekeepers, singers, and Levites, and placed his brother Hanani in charge. The chapter records the genealogy of those who first returned from exile with Zerubbabel — the same register as Ezra 2.

verses.kjv: And all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the street that was before the water gate; and they spake unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded to Israel.
verses.modern: All the people gathered together as one in the square before the Water Gate. They told Ezra the scribe to bring out the Book of the Law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded for Israel.

verses.kjv: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women, and all that could hear with understanding, upon the first day of the seventh month.
verses.modern: So Ezra the priest brought the Law before the assembly — both men and women and all who could understand — on the first day of the seventh month.

verses.kjv: And he read therein before the street that was before the water gate from the morning until midday, before the men and the women, and those that could understand; and the ears of all the people were attentive unto the book of the law.
verses.modern: He read from it in the square before the Water Gate from early morning until midday, in the presence of the men, the women, and those who could understand. All the people listened attentively to the Book of the Law.

verses.kjv: And Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Urijah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchiah, and Hashum, and Hashbadana, Zechariah, and Meshullam.
verses.modern: Ezra the scribe stood on a high wooden platform that had been made for the occasion. Standing beside him on his right were Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, and on his left were Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam.

verses.kjv: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people; (for he was above all the people;) and when he opened it, all the people stood up:
verses.modern: Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people, for he was standing above them. When he opened it, all the people stood up.

verses.kjv: And Ezra blessed the LORD, the great God. And all the people answered, Amen, Amen, with lifting up their hands: and they bowed their heads, and worshipped the LORD with their faces to the ground.
verses.modern: Ezra praised the LORD, the great God. All the people answered, "Amen, Amen!" lifting up their hands. Then they bowed down and worshiped the LORD with their faces to the ground.

verses.kjv: Also Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law: and the people stood in their place.
verses.modern: Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodijah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, and Pelaiah — the Levites — helped the people understand the Law while the people stood in their places.

verses.kjv: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.
verses.modern: They read from the Book of the Law of God, translating and explaining it so that the people could understand what was being read.

verses.kjv: And Nehemiah, which is the Tirshatha, and Ezra the priest the scribe, and the Levites that taught the people, said unto all the people, This day is holy unto the LORD your God; mourn not, nor weep. For all the people wept, when they heard the words of the law.
verses.modern: Then Nehemiah the governor, Ezra the priest and scribe, and the Levites who were teaching the people said to all the people, "This day is holy to the LORD Your God. Do not mourn or weep." For all the people had been weeping as they listened to the words of the Law.

verses.kjv: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our LORD: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.
verses.modern: Nehemiah said to them, "Go, eat rich food and drink sweet drinks, and send portions to those for whom nothing is prepared, for this day is holy to our Lord. Do not grieve, for the joy of the LORD is Your strength."

verses.kjv: So the Levites stilled all the people, saying, Hold your peace, for the day is holy; neither be ye grieved.
verses.modern: The Levites quieted all the people, saying, "Be still, for this day is holy; do not grieve."

verses.kjv: And all the people went their way to eat, and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great mirth, because they had understood the words that were declared unto them.
verses.modern: Then all the people went away to eat and drink, to send portions and celebrate with great joy, because they now understood the words that had been made known to them.

verses.kjv: And on the second day were gathered together the chief of the fathers of all the people, the priests, and the Levites, unto Ezra the scribe, even to understand the words of the law.
verses.modern: On the second day the heads of families of all the people, together with the priests and the Levites, gathered around Ezra the scribe to study the words of the Law.

verses.kjv: And they found written in the law which the LORD had commanded by Moses, that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month:
verses.modern: They found written in the Law that the LORD had commanded through Moses that the people of Israel should live in shelters during the feast of the seventh month,

verses.kjv: And that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities, and in Jerusalem, saying, Go forth unto the mount, and fetch olive branches, and pine branches, and myrtle branches, and palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make booths, as it is written.
verses.modern: that they should proclaim in all their towns and in Jerusalem, "Go out to the hill country and bring back branches of olive, wild olive, myrtle, palm, and other leafy trees to make shelters," as it is written.

verses.kjv: So the people went forth, and brought them, and made themselves booths, every one upon the roof of his house, and in their courts, and in the courts of the house of God, and in the street of the water gate, and in the street of the gate of Ephraim.
verses.modern: So the people went out and brought branches and built shelters for themselves — each on His rooftop, in His courtyard, in the courts of the house of God, in the square at the Water Gate, and in the square at the Gate of Ephraim.

verses.kjv: And all the congregation of them that were come again out of the captivity made booths, and sat under the booths: for since the days of Jeshua the son of Nun unto that day had not the children of Israel done so. And there was very great gladness.
verses.modern: The whole assembly of those who had returned from exile built shelters and lived in them. The people of Israel had not done this from the days of Joshua the son of Nun until that day. And there was very great rejoicing.

verses.kjv: Also day by day, from the first day unto the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. And they kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according unto the manner.
verses.modern: Day after day, from the first day to the last, Ezra read from the Book of the Law of God. They celebrated the feast for seven days, and on the eighth day held a solemn assembly, according to the rule.

chapters.summary: Ezra read the Book of the Law aloud to all the people from morning until midday at the Water Gate, and the Levites helped the people understand it. The people wept when they heard the law, but Nehemiah told them to rejoice; they then celebrated the Feast of Tabernacles.

verses.kjv: Now in the twenty and fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, and with sackclothes, and earth upon them.
verses.modern: On the twenty-fourth day of the same month, the people of Israel assembled with fasting, in sackcloth, and with dirt on their heads.

verses.kjv: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.
verses.modern: Those of Israelite descent separated themselves from all foreigners. They stood and confessed their sins and the iniquities of their ancestors.

verses.kjv: And they stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of the LORD their God one fourth part of the day; and another fourth part they confessed, and worshipped the LORD their God.
verses.modern: They stood where they were and read from the Book of the Law of the LORD their God for a quarter of the day, and spent another quarter confessing and worshiping the LORD their God.

verses.kjv: Then stood up upon the stairs, of the Levites, Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani, and cried with a loud voice unto the LORD their God.
verses.modern: Standing on the Levites' platform were Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani. They cried out with a loud voice to the LORD their God.

verses.kjv: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, Stand up and bless the LORD your God for ever and ever: and blessed be thy glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise.
verses.modern: The Levites — Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah — said, "Stand up and bless the LORD Your God from everlasting to everlasting. Blessed be Your glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise.

verses.kjv: Thou, even thou, art LORD alone; thou hast made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth, and all things that are therein, the seas, and all that is therein, and thou preservest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth thee.
verses.modern: You are the LORD, You alone. You have made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth and all that is on it, the seas and all that is in them. You preserve all of them. The host of heaven worships You.

verses.kjv: Thou art the LORD the God, who didst choose Abram, and broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gavest him the name of Abraham;
verses.modern: You are the LORD God, Who chose Abram and brought him out of Ur of the Chaldeans and gave Him the name Abraham.

verses.kjv: And foundest his heart faithful before thee, and madest a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Jebusites, and the Girgashites, to give it, I say, to his seed, and hast performed thy words; for thou art righteous:
verses.modern: You found His heart faithful before You and made a covenant with Him to give the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, and the Girgashites — to give it to His descendants. You have kept Your promise, for You are righteous.

verses.kjv: And didst see the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heardest their cry by the Red sea;
verses.modern: You saw the affliction of our ancestors in Egypt and heard their cry by the Red Sea.

verses.kjv: And shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharaoh, and on all his servants, and on all the people of his land: for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them. So didst thou get thee a name, as it is this day.
verses.modern: You performed signs and wonders against Pharaoh, against all his servants, and against all the people of his land, for you knew how arrogantly they treated our ancestors. You made a name for yourself that endures to this day.

verses.kjv: And thou didst divide the sea before them, so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land; and their persecutors thou threwest into the deeps, as a stone into the mighty waters.
verses.modern: You divided the sea before them, so they passed through it on dry ground. But their pursuers you hurled into the depths, like a stone into mighty waters.

verses.kjv: Moreover thou leddest them in the day by a cloudy pillar; and in the night by a pillar of fire, to give them light in the way wherein they should go.
verses.modern: You led them with a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night to light the way they were to take.

verses.kjv: Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai, and spakest with them from heaven, and gavest them right judgments, and true laws, good statutes and commandments:
verses.modern: You came down on Mount Sinai and spoke with them from heaven. You gave them right judgments and true laws, good statutes and commandments.

verses.kjv: And madest known unto them thy holy sabbath, and commandedst them precepts, statutes, and laws, by the hand of Moses thy servant:
verses.modern: You made known to them your holy Sabbath and gave them commandments, statutes, and a law through your servant Moses.

verses.kjv: And gavest them bread from heaven for their hunger, and broughtest forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst, and promisedst them that they should go in to possess the land which thou hadst sworn to give them.
verses.modern: You gave them bread from heaven for their hunger and brought forth water from the rock for their thirst. You told them to go in and possess the land you had sworn with your hand to give them.

verses.kjv: But they and our fathers dealt proudly, and hardened their necks, and hearkened not to thy commandments,
verses.modern: But they and our ancestors acted arrogantly. They became stubborn and did not obey your commandments.

verses.kjv: And refused to obey, neither were mindful of thy wonders that thou didst among them; but hardened their necks, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage: but thou art a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and forsookest them not.
verses.modern: They refused to listen and did not remember the wonders you performed among them. They stiffened their necks and in their rebellion appointed a leader to return to slavery. But you are a God ready to forgive, gracious and merciful, longsuffering and of great kindness, and you did not abandon them.

verses.kjv: Yea, when they had made them a molten calf, and said, This is thy God that brought thee up out of Egypt, and had wrought great provocations;
verses.modern: Even when they made for themselves a golden calf and said, 'This is your God Who brought you up out of Egypt,' and committed great blasphemies,

verses.kjv: Yet thou in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness: the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to shew them light, and the way wherein they should go.
verses.modern: Yet you in your great mercy did not abandon them in the wilderness. The pillar of cloud did not stop leading them by day, nor the pillar of fire by night to light their way.

verses.kjv: Thou gavest also thy good spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth, and gavest them water for their thirst.
verses.modern: You gave your good Spirit to instruct them. You did not withhold your manna from their mouths, and you gave them water when they were thirsty.

verses.kjv: Yea, forty years didst thou sustain them in the wilderness, so that they lacked nothing; their clothes waxed not old, and their feet swelled not.
verses.modern: For forty years you sustained them in the wilderness. They lacked nothing; their clothes did not wear out and their feet did not swell.

verses.kjv: Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and nations, and didst divide them into corners: so they possessed the land of Sihon, and the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.
verses.modern: You gave them kingdoms and peoples and divided the lands among them. They took possession of the land of Sihon king of Heshbon and the land of Og king of Bashan.

verses.kjv: Their children also multipliedst thou as the stars of heaven, and broughtest them into the land, concerning which thou hadst promised to their fathers, that they should go in to possess it.
verses.modern: You multiplied their descendants like the stars of heaven and brought them into the land you had told their ancestors to enter and possess.

verses.kjv: So the children went in and possessed the land, and thou subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gavest them into their hands, with their kings, and the people of the land, that they might do with them as they would.
verses.modern: So their descendants went in and possessed the land. You subdued the Canaanites before them and handed their kings and the peoples of the land over to them, to do with as they pleased.

verses.kjv: And they took strong cities, and a fat land, and possessed houses full of all goods, wells digged, vineyards, and oliveyards, and fruit trees in abundance: so they did eat, and were filled, and became fat, and delighted themselves in thy great goodness.
verses.modern: They captured fortified cities and fertile land. They took possession of houses full of all good things, cisterns already dug, vineyards, olive groves, and fruit trees in abundance. They ate and were satisfied and became well-fed and lived in luxury in your great goodness.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against thee, and cast thy law behind their backs, and slew thy prophets which testified against them to turn them to thee, and they wrought great provocations.
verses.modern: But they were disobedient and rebelled against you. They threw your law behind their backs and killed your prophets who had warned them to return to you. They committed terrible blasphemies.

verses.kjv: Therefore thou deliveredst them into the hand of their enemies, who vexed them: and in the time of their trouble, when they cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven; and according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours, who saved them out of the hand of their enemies.
verses.modern: So you handed them over to their enemies, who oppressed them. But when they cried out to you in the time of their suffering, you heard from heaven, and according to your great mercy you gave them deliverers who rescued them from the hands of their enemies.

verses.kjv: But after they had rest, they did evil again before thee: therefore leftest thou them in the hand of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them: yet when they returned, and cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven; and many times didst thou deliver them according to thy mercies;
verses.modern: But as soon as they had relief, they did evil again before you. So you abandoned them to the hand of their enemies. They ruled over them. Then when they cried out to you again, you heard from heaven and delivered them many times in your mercy.

verses.kjv: And testifiedst against them, that thou mightest bring them again unto thy law: yet they dealt proudly, and hearkened not unto thy commandments, but sinned against thy judgments, (which if a man do, he shall live in them;) and withdrew the shoulder, and hardened their neck, and would not hear.
verses.modern: You warned them to return to your law. But they acted arrogantly and did not obey your commandments. They sinned against your ordinances — by which a person will live if he does them. They stubbornly turned their backs, stiffened their necks, and would not listen.

verses.kjv: Yet many years didst thou forbear them, and testifiedst against them by thy spirit in thy prophets: yet would they not give ear: therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the people of the lands.
verses.modern: For many years you bore with them. You warned them by your Spirit through your prophets, yet they would not listen. So you handed them over to the peoples of the surrounding lands.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless for thy great mercies' sake thou didst not utterly consume them, nor forsake them; for thou art a gracious and merciful God.
verses.modern: Yet in your great mercy you did not utterly destroy them or abandon them, for you are a gracious and merciful God.

verses.kjv: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the terrible God, who keepest covenant and mercy, let not all the trouble seem little before thee, that hath come upon us, on our kings, on our princes, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all thy people, since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day.
verses.modern: Now therefore, our God — the great, the mighty, and the awesome God, Who keeps covenant and mercy — do not let all the hardship seem small to you that has come upon us: our kings, our officials, our priests, our prophets, our ancestors. All your people, from the days of the kings of Assyria to this day.

verses.kjv: Howbeit thou art just in all that is brought upon us; for thou hast done right, but we have done wickedly:
verses.modern: You have been righteous in all that has come upon us, for you have acted faithfully and we have acted wickedly.

verses.kjv: Neither have our kings, our princes, our priests, nor our fathers, kept thy law, nor hearkened unto thy commandments and thy testimonies, wherewith thou didst testify against them.
verses.modern: Our kings, our officials, our priests, and our ancestors have not kept your law or paid attention to your commandments and warnings you gave them.

verses.kjv: For they have not served thee in their kingdom, and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them, and in the large and fat land which thou gavest before them, neither turned they from their wicked works.
verses.modern: Even in their own kingdom, despite all your great goodness toward them and despite the broad and fertile land you gave them, they did not serve you and did not turn from their wicked ways.

verses.kjv: Behold, we are servants this day, and for the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof, behold, we are servants in it:
verses.modern: See, we are slaves today — slaves in the land you gave to our ancestors so they could eat its fruit and its good gifts.

verses.kjv: And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins: also they have dominion over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.
verses.modern: Its abundant produce goes to the kings you have placed over us because of our sins. They rule over our bodies and over our livestock as they please. We are in great distress.

verses.kjv: And because of all this we make a sure covenant, and write it; and our princes, Levites, and priests, seal unto it.
verses.modern: Because of all this we are making a firm covenant in writing, and our officials, Levites, and priests are putting their seals on it."

chapters.summary: The Israelites assembled in fasting and sackcloth and confessed their sins. The Levites led a long prayer recounting God’s faithfulness from Abraham through the exodus, the wilderness, the conquest, the judges, and the exile, acknowledging that God was just in all that had come upon them.

verses.kjv: Now those that sealed were, Nehemiah, the Tirshatha, the son of Hachaliah, and Zidkijah,
verses.modern: Those who sealed it were: Nehemiah the governor, son of Hachaliah, and Zedekiah,

verses.kjv: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,
verses.modern: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,

verses.kjv: Pashur, Amariah, Malchijah,
verses.modern: Pashhur, Amariah, Malchijah,

verses.kjv: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,
verses.modern: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,

verses.kjv: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,
verses.modern: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,

verses.kjv: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,
verses.modern: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,

verses.kjv: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,
verses.modern: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,

verses.kjv: Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah: these were the priests.
verses.modern: Maaziah, Bilgai, and Shemaiah. These were the priests.

verses.kjv: And the Levites: both Jeshua the son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel;
verses.modern: The Levites: Jeshua the son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel;

verses.kjv: And their brethren, Shebaniah, Hodijah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,
verses.modern: their brothers: Shebaniah, Hodijah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,

verses.kjv: Micha, Rehob, Hashabiah,
verses.modern: Mica, Rehob, Hashabiah,

verses.kjv: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,
verses.modern: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,

verses.kjv: Hodijah, Bani, Beninu.
verses.modern: Hodijah, Bani, and Beninu.

verses.kjv: The chief of the people; Parosh, Pahathmoab, Elam, Zatthu, Bani,
verses.modern: The leaders of the people: Parosh, Pahath-moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,

verses.kjv: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,
verses.modern: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,

verses.kjv: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,
verses.modern: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,

verses.kjv: Ater, Hizkijah, Azzur,
verses.modern: Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,

verses.kjv: Hodijah, Hashum, Bezai,
verses.modern: Hodijah, Hashum, Bezai,

verses.kjv: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,
verses.modern: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,

verses.kjv: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,
verses.modern: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,

verses.kjv: Meshezabeel, Zadok, Jaddua,
verses.modern: Meshezabeel, Zadok, Jaddua,

verses.kjv: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,
verses.modern: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,

verses.kjv: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hashub,
verses.modern: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub,

verses.kjv: Hallohesh, Pileha, Shobek,
verses.modern: Hallohesh, Pileha, Shobek,

verses.kjv: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,
verses.modern: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,

verses.kjv: And Ahijah, Hanan, Anan,
verses.modern: Ahijah, Hanan, Anan,

verses.kjv: Malluch, Harim, Baanah.
verses.modern: Malluch, Harim, and Baanah.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the porters, the singers, the Nethinims, and all they that had separated themselves from the people of the lands unto the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, every one having knowledge, and having understanding;
verses.modern: The rest of the people — the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, the temple servants, and all who had separated themselves from the peoples of the lands to the Law of God, together with their wives, sons, and daughters, all who had knowledge and understanding —

verses.kjv: They clave to their brethren, their nobles, and entered into a curse, and into an oath, to walk in God's law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of the LORD our LORD, and his judgments and his statutes;
verses.modern: joined their brothers, their nobles, and bound themselves with a curse and an oath to walk in God's Law, which was given through Moses the servant of God, and to observe and keep all the commandments of the LORD our Lord, and His ordinances and statutes.

verses.kjv: And that we would not give our daughters unto the people of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons:
verses.modern: We would not give our daughters to the peoples of the land or take their daughters for our sons.

verses.kjv: And if the people of the land bring ware or any victuals on the sabbath day to sell, that we would not buy it of them on the sabbath, or on the holy day: and that we would leave the seventh year, and the exaction of every debt.
verses.modern: If the peoples of the land bring goods or any grain to sell on the Sabbath, we would not buy from them on the Sabbath or on any holy day. We would forego the produce of the seventh year and the cancellation of every debt.

verses.kjv: Also we made ordinances for us, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of God;
verses.modern: We also took on the obligation to give a third of a shekel each year for the service of the house of God:

verses.kjv: For the shewbread, and for the continual meat offering, and for the continual burnt offering, of the sabbaths, of the new moons, for the set feasts, and for the holy things, and for the sin offerings to make an atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of God.
verses.modern: for the bread of the Presence, the regular grain offering, the regular burnt offering, the Sabbaths, the new moons, the appointed festivals, the holy things, the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of God.

verses.kjv: And we cast the lots among the priests, the Levites, and the people, for the wood offering, to bring it into the house of our God, after the houses of our fathers, at times appointed year by year, to burn upon the altar of the LORD our God, as it is written in the law:
verses.modern: We also cast lots among the priests, the Levites, and the people for the wood offering, to bring it to the house of our God by our ancestral houses at appointed times each year, to burn on the altar of the LORD our God, as it is written in the Law.

verses.kjv: And to bring the firstfruits of our ground, and the firstfruits of all fruit of all trees, year by year, unto the house of the LORD:
verses.modern: We obligated ourselves to bring the firstfruits of our ground and the firstfruits of every fruit tree year by year to the house of the LORD,

verses.kjv: Also the firstborn of our sons, and of our cattle, as it is written in the law, and the firstlings of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, unto the priests that minister in the house of our God:
verses.modern: to bring to the house of our God, to the priests who minister there, the firstborn of our sons and of our cattle, as written in the Law, and the firstborn of our herds and our flocks.

verses.kjv: And that we should bring the firstfruits of our dough, and our offerings, and the fruit of all manner of trees, of wine and of oil, unto the priests, to the chambers of the house of our God; and the tithes of our ground unto the Levites, that the same Levites might have the tithes in all the cities of our tillage.
verses.modern: We would also bring to the priests in the storerooms of the house of our God the first of our dough, our contributions, the fruit of every tree, wine, and oil. And we would bring the tithe of our ground to the Levites, for it is the Levites who collect the tithes in all our agricultural towns.

verses.kjv: And the priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites, when the Levites take tithes: and the Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes unto the house of our God, to the chambers, into the treasure house.
verses.modern: The priest, a son of Aaron, shall accompany the Levites when they receive the tithes, and the Levites shall bring up a tithe of the tithes to the house of our God, to the storerooms of the treasury.

verses.kjv: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the offering of the corn, of the new wine, and the oil, unto the chambers, where are the vessels of the sanctuary, and the priests that minister, and the porters, and the singers: and we will not forsake the house of our God.
verses.modern: For the people of Israel and the descendants of Levi shall bring the contribution of grain, new wine, and oil to the storerooms where the vessels of the sanctuary are kept, where the ministering priests, the gatekeepers, and the singers are. We will not neglect the house of our God.

chapters.summary: The leaders, Levites, and priests sealed a written covenant, and the people bound themselves by oath to walk in God’s law. They pledged not to intermarry with surrounding peoples, to keep the Sabbath, to support the temple with the yearly third-of-a-shekel tax, and to bring their tithes and firstfruits.

verses.kjv: And the rulers of the people dwelt at Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts to dwell in other cities.
verses.modern: The leaders of the people settled in Jerusalem. The rest of the people cast lots to bring one in ten to live in Jerusalem, the holy city, while the other nine tenths remained in the other towns.

verses.kjv: And the people blessed all the men, that willingly offered themselves to dwell at Jerusalem.
verses.modern: The people blessed all the men who volunteered to live in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Now these are the chief of the province that dwelt in Jerusalem: but in the cities of Judah dwelt every one in his possession in their cities, to wit, Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants.
verses.modern: These are the leaders of the province who settled in Jerusalem. (But in the towns of Judah, everyone lived on his own property in their towns — Israel, the priests, the Levites, the temple servants, and the descendants of Solomon's servants.)

verses.kjv: And at Jerusalem dwelt certain of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah; Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalaleel, of the children of Perez;
verses.modern: Some of the people of Judah and some of the people of Benjamin settled in Jerusalem. From the descendants of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, son of Zechariah, son of Amariah, son of Shephatiah, son of Mahalalel, of the descendants of Perez;

verses.kjv: And Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of Shiloni.
verses.modern: Maaseiah the son of Baruch, son of Col-hozeh, son of Hazaiah, son of Adaiah, son of Joiarib, son of Zechariah, son of Shiloni.

verses.kjv: All the sons of Perez that dwelt at Jerusalem were four hundred threescore and eight valiant men.
verses.modern: All the descendants of Perez who settled in Jerusalem were 468 capable men.

verses.kjv: And these are the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jesaiah.
verses.modern: From the descendants of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, son of Joed, son of Pedaiah, son of Kolaiah, son of Maaseiah, son of Ithiel, son of Jeshaiah.

verses.kjv: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty and eight.
verses.modern: after him Gabbai and Sallai — 928.

verses.kjv: And Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer: and Judah the son of Senuah was second over the city.
verses.modern: Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer, and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second in charge of the city.

verses.kjv: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin.
verses.modern: From the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin,

verses.kjv: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, was the ruler of the house of God.
verses.modern: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, son of Meshullam, son of Zadok, son of Meraioth, son of Ahitub — the officer in charge of the house of God,

verses.kjv: And their brethren that did the work of the house were eight hundred twenty and two: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah,
verses.modern: their brothers who did the work of the temple — 822. Adaiah the son of Jeroham, son of Pelaliah, son of Amzi, son of Zechariah, son of Pashhur, son of Malchijah,

verses.kjv: And his brethren, chief of the fathers, two hundred forty and two: and Amashai the son of Azareel, the son of Ahasai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
verses.modern: his brothers, heads of families — 242. Amashai the son of Azareel, son of Ahasai, son of Meshillemoth, son of Immer,

verses.kjv: And their brethren, mighty men of valour, an hundred twenty and eight: and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of one of the great men.
verses.modern: their brothers, men of great ability — 128. Their overseer was Zabdiel the son of one of the great men.

verses.kjv: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
verses.modern: From the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, son of Azrikam, son of Hashabiah, son of Bunni;

verses.kjv: And Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chief of the Levites, had the oversight of the outward business of the house of God.
verses.modern: Shabbethai and Jozabad, from the heads of the Levites, who were in charge of the outside work of the house of God;

verses.kjv: And Mattaniah the son of Micha, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, was the principal to begin the thanksgiving in prayer: and Bakbukiah the second among his brethren, and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
verses.modern: Mattaniah the son of Mica, son of Zabdi, son of Asaph, who was the leader of the opening of prayer and thanksgiving, and Bakbukiah, second among his brothers. Abda the son of Shammua, son of Galal, son of Jeduthun.

verses.kjv: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred fourscore and four.
verses.modern: All the Levites in the holy city were 284.

verses.kjv: Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brethren that kept the gates, were an hundred seventy and two.
verses.modern: The gatekeepers — Akkub, Talmon, and their brothers who kept watch at the gates — were 172.

verses.kjv: And the residue of Israel, of the priests, and the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, every one in his inheritance.
verses.modern: The rest of Israel — priests and Levites — were in all the towns of Judah, each on his own inherited property.

verses.kjv: But the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gispa were over the Nethinims.
verses.modern: The temple servants lived on the hill of Ophel, and Ziha and Gishpa were over the temple servants.

verses.kjv: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micha. Of the sons of Asaph, the singers were over the business of the house of God.
verses.modern: The overseer of the Levites in Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, son of Hashabiah, son of Mattaniah, son of Mica, from the descendants of Asaph. The singers were responsible for the service of the house of God.

verses.kjv: For it was the king's commandment concerning them, that a certain portion should be for the singers, due for every day.
verses.modern: For there was a royal command concerning them, and a fixed provision for the singers each day.

verses.kjv: And Pethahiah the son of Meshezabeel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king's hand in all matters concerning the people.
verses.modern: Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the descendants of Zerah the son of Judah, was the king's agent in all matters concerning the people.

verses.kjv: And for the villages, with their fields, some of the children of Judah dwelt at Kirjatharba, and in the villages thereof, and at Dibon, and in the villages thereof, and at Jekabzeel, and in the villages thereof,
verses.modern: As for the villages with their fields: some of the people of Judah lived in Kiriath-arba and its villages, in Dibon and its villages, in Jekabzeel and its villages,

verses.kjv: And at Jeshua, and at Moladah, and at Bethphelet,
verses.modern: in Jeshua, Moladah, Beth-pelet,

verses.kjv: And at Hazarshual, and at Beersheba, and in the villages thereof,
verses.modern: Hazar-shual, Beersheba and its villages,

verses.kjv: And at Ziklag, and at Mekonah, and in the villages thereof,
verses.modern: Ziklag, Meconah and its villages,

verses.kjv: And at Enrimmon, and at Zareah, and at Jarmuth,
verses.modern: En-rimmon, Zareah, Jarmuth,

verses.kjv: Zanoah, Adullam, and in their villages, at Lachish, and the fields thereof, at Azekah, and in the villages thereof. And they dwelt from Beersheba unto the valley of Hinnom.
verses.modern: Zanoah, Adullam. Their villages, Lachish and its fields, and Azekah and its villages. They settled from Beersheba to the Valley of Hinnom.

verses.kjv: The children also of Benjamin from Geba dwelt at Michmash, and Aija, and Bethel, and in their villages,
verses.modern: The descendants of Benjamin from Geba settled in Michmash, Aija, Bethel and its villages,

verses.kjv: And at Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
verses.modern: Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,

verses.kjv: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
verses.modern: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,

verses.kjv: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
verses.modern: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,

verses.kjv: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.
verses.modern: Lod, and Ono — the Valley of Craftsmen.

verses.kjv: And of the Levites were divisions in Judah, and in Benjamin.
verses.modern: Some divisions of the Levites in Judah were assigned to Benjamin.

chapters.summary: The leaders lived in Jerusalem, and one out of every ten people was chosen by lot to settle in the holy city. The chapter lists the heads of families from Judah and Benjamin, the priests, and the Levites who dwelt in Jerusalem and the surrounding towns.

verses.kjv: Now these are the priests and the Levites that went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
verses.modern: These are the priests and Levites who came up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,

verses.kjv: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,
verses.modern: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,

verses.kjv: Shechaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,
verses.modern: Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,

verses.kjv: Iddo, Ginnetho, Abijah,
verses.modern: Iddo, Ginnetho, Abijah,

verses.kjv: Miamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,
verses.modern: Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,

verses.kjv: Shemaiah, and Joiarib, Jedaiah,
verses.modern: Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah,

verses.kjv: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These were the chief of the priests and of their brethren in the days of Jeshua.
verses.modern: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, and Jedaiah. These were the leaders of the priests and their brothers in the days of Jeshua.

verses.kjv: Moreover the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, which was over the thanksgiving, he and his brethren.
verses.modern: The Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, who with his brothers was in charge of the songs of thanksgiving.

verses.kjv: Also Bakbukiah and Unni, their brethren, were over against them in the watches.
verses.modern: Bakbukiah and Unni and their brothers stood opposite them in the services.

verses.kjv: And Jeshua begat Joiakim, Joiakim also begat Eliashib, and Eliashib begat Joiada,
verses.modern: Jeshua begat Joiakim, Joiakim begat Eliashib, Eliashib begat Joiada,

verses.kjv: And Joiada begat Jonathan, and Jonathan begat Jaddua.
verses.modern: Joiada begat Jonathan, and Jonathan begat Jaddua.

verses.kjv: And in the days of Joiakim were priests, the chief of the fathers: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;
verses.modern: In the days of Joiakim, the priestly family heads were: for Seraiah, Meraiah; for Jeremiah, Hananiah;

verses.kjv: Of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;
verses.modern: for Ezra, Meshullam; for Amariah, Jehohanan;

verses.kjv: Of Melicu, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;
verses.modern: for Melicu, Jonathan; for Shebaniah, Joseph;

verses.kjv: Of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;
verses.modern: for Harim, Adna; for Meraioth, Helkai;

verses.kjv: Of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;
verses.modern: for Iddo, Zechariah; for Ginnethon, Meshullam;

verses.kjv: Of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;
verses.modern: for Abijah, Zichri; for Miniamin, for Moadiah, Piltai;

verses.kjv: Of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;
verses.modern: for Bilgah, Shammua; for Shemaiah, Jehonathan;

verses.kjv: And of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;
verses.modern: for Joiarib, Mattenai; for Jedaiah, Uzzi;

verses.kjv: Of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;
verses.modern: for Sallai, Kallai; for Amok, Eber;

verses.kjv: Of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethaneel.
verses.modern: for Hilkiah, Hashabiah; for Jedaiah, Nethanel.

verses.kjv: The Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, were recorded chief of the fathers: also the priests, to the reign of Darius the Persian.
verses.modern: The Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua were recorded as heads of families, as were the priests, until the reign of Darius the Persian.

verses.kjv: The sons of Levi, the chief of the fathers, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.
verses.modern: The sons of Levi, the heads of families, were recorded in the Book of the Chronicles until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.

verses.kjv: And the chief of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brethren over against them, to praise and to give thanks, according to the commandment of David the man of God, ward over against ward.
verses.modern: The heads of the Levites were Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brothers over against them, to praise and give thanks, according to the commandment of David the man of God, group corresponding to group.

verses.kjv: Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, were porters keeping the ward at the thresholds of the gates.
verses.modern: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were gatekeepers standing guard at the thresholds of the gates.

verses.kjv: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.
verses.modern: These served in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor and of Ezra the priest and scribe.

verses.kjv: And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, to keep the dedication with gladness, both with thanksgivings, and with singing, with cymbals, psalteries, and with harps.
verses.modern: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem, the Levites were sought out from wherever they lived and were brought to Jerusalem to celebrate the dedication with joy — with thanksgiving, singing, cymbals, harps, and lyres.

verses.kjv: And the sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain country round about Jerusalem, and from the villages of Netophathi;
verses.modern: The sons of the singers gathered from the surrounding region around Jerusalem and from the villages of the Netophathites,

verses.kjv: Also from the house of Gilgal, and out of the fields of Geba and Azmavet: for the singers had builded them villages round about Jerusalem.
verses.modern: from Beth-gilgal and from the farms of Geba and Azmaveth, for the singers had built villages for themselves around Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And the priests and the Levites purified themselves, and purified the people, and the gates, and the wall.
verses.modern: The priests and the Levites purified themselves. They purified the people, the gates, and the wall.

verses.kjv: Then I brought up the princes of Judah upon the wall, and appointed two great companies of them that gave thanks, whereof one went on the right hand upon the wall toward the dung gate:
verses.modern: Then I brought the leaders of Judah up on top of the wall and appointed two large choirs to give thanks. One went in procession to the right along the top of the wall toward the Refuse Gate.

verses.kjv: And after them went Hoshaiah, and half of the princes of Judah,
verses.modern: Behind them went Hoshaiah and half of the leaders of Judah,

verses.kjv: And Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,
verses.modern: with Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,

verses.kjv: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,
verses.modern: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,

verses.kjv: And certain of the priests' sons with trumpets; namely, Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Michaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph:
verses.modern: some of the sons of the priests with trumpets: Zechariah the son of Jonathan, son of Shemaiah, son of Mattaniah, son of Michaiah, son of Zaccur, son of Asaph;

verses.kjv: And his brethren, Shemaiah, and Azarael, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God, and Ezra the scribe before them.
verses.modern: his brothers Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God. Ezra the scribe walked ahead of them.

verses.kjv: And at the fountain gate, which was over against them, they went up by the stairs of the city of David, at the going up of the wall, above the house of David, even unto the water gate eastward.
verses.modern: At the Fountain Gate they went straight up the stairs of the City of David, at the ascent of the wall, above the house of David, to the Water Gate on the east.

verses.kjv: And the other company of them that gave thanks went over against them, and I after them, and the half of the people upon the wall, from beyond the tower of the furnaces even unto the broad wall;
verses.modern: The second choir giving thanks went to the left. I followed it with half of the people along the top of the wall, past the Tower of the Ovens to the Broad Wall,

verses.kjv: And from above the gate of Ephraim, and above the old gate, and above the fish gate, and the tower of Hananeel, and the tower of Meah, even unto the sheep gate: and they stood still in the prison gate.
verses.modern: over the Gate of Ephraim, over the Jeshanah Gate, over the Fish Gate, the Tower of Hananel, and the Tower of the Hundred, to the Sheep Gate. They came to a halt at the Gate of the Guard.

verses.kjv: So stood the two companies of them that gave thanks in the house of God, and I, and the half of the rulers with me:
verses.modern: So both choirs took their places in the house of God, and so did I, along with half of the officials with me,

verses.kjv: And the priests; Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Michaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;
verses.modern: the priests Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Michaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets,

verses.kjv: And Maaseiah, and Shemaiah, and Eleazar, and Uzzi, and Jehohanan, and Malchijah, and Elam, and Ezer. And the singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer.
verses.modern: Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, and Ezer. The singers sang loudly, with Jezrahiah as their leader.

verses.kjv: Also that day they offered great sacrifices, and rejoiced: for God had made them rejoice with great joy: the wives also and the children rejoiced: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.
verses.modern: That day they offered great sacrifices and rejoiced, for God had made them rejoice with great joy. The women and children also rejoiced. The joy of Jerusalem was heard far away.

verses.kjv: And at that time were some appointed over the chambers for the treasures, for the offerings, for the firstfruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them out of the fields of the cities the portions of the law for the priests and Levites: for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites that waited.
verses.modern: On that day men were appointed over the storerooms for the contributions, the firstfruits, and the tithes, to gather into them the portions required by the Law from the fields of the towns for the priests and Levites, for Judah rejoiced over the priests and Levites who were serving.

verses.kjv: And both the singers and the porters kept the ward of their God, and the ward of the purification, according to the commandment of David, and of Solomon his son.
verses.modern: They performed the service of their God and the service of purification, as did the singers and the gatekeepers, according to the command of David and his son Solomon.

verses.kjv: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there were chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving unto God.
verses.modern: For long ago in the days of David and Asaph, there were directors of the singers and songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.

verses.kjv: And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel, and in the days of Nehemiah, gave the portions of the singers and the porters, every day his portion: and they sanctified holy things unto the Levites; and the Levites sanctified them unto the children of Aaron.
verses.modern: In the days of Zerubbabel and in the days of Nehemiah, all Israel gave the daily portions for the singers and the gatekeepers. They also set apart the portion for the Levites, and the Levites set apart the portion for the sons of Aaron.

chapters.summary: The chapter records the priests and Levites who returned with Zerubbabel and those who served in subsequent generations. At the dedication of the wall, two great processions marched in opposite directions on top of the wall and met at the temple with singing and sacrifices of great joy.

verses.kjv: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people; and therein was found written, that the Ammonite and the Moabite should not come into the congregation of God for ever;
verses.modern: On that day the Book of Moses was read aloud to the people. In it was found written that no Ammonite or Moabite should ever be admitted into the assembly of God,

verses.kjv: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, that he should curse them: howbeit our God turned the curse into a blessing.
verses.modern: because they had not met the people of Israel with bread and water but had hired Balaam to curse them — though our God turned the curse into a blessing.

verses.kjv: Now it came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated from Israel all the mixed multitude.
verses.modern: When the people heard this law, they separated from Israel all the mixed multitude.

verses.kjv: And before this, Eliashib the priest, having the oversight of the chamber of the house of our God, was allied unto Tobiah:
verses.modern: Before this, Eliashib the priest, who had been placed in charge of the storerooms of the house of our God, and who was related to Tobiah,

verses.kjv: And he had prepared for him a great chamber, where aforetime they laid the meat offerings, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithes of the corn, the new wine, and the oil, which was commanded to be given to the Levites, and the singers, and the porters; and the offerings of the priests.
verses.modern: had prepared for him a large room where previously they had stored the grain offerings, the frankincense, the vessels, the tithes of grain, new wine, and oil, which were commanded for the Levites, the singers, and the gatekeepers, and the contributions for the priests.

verses.kjv: But in all this time was not I at Jerusalem: for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon came I unto the king, and after certain days obtained I leave of the king:
verses.modern: While all this was happening I was not in Jerusalem, for in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I had gone to the king. After some time I asked leave of the king

verses.kjv: And I came to Jerusalem, and understood of the evil that Eliashib did for Tobiah, in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of God.
verses.modern: I returned to Jerusalem. I then discovered the evil that Eliashib had done for Tobiah, in preparing a room for him in the courts of the house of God.

verses.kjv: And it grieved me sore: therefore I cast forth all the household stuff of Tobiah out of the chamber.
verses.modern: This made me very angry. I threw all of Tobiah's household goods out of the room.

verses.kjv: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the chambers: and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God, with the meat offering and the frankincense.
verses.modern: I gave orders. They cleansed the rooms. Then I brought back the vessels of the house of God, the grain offering, and the frankincense.

verses.kjv: And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them: for the Levites and the singers, that did the work, were fled every one to his field.
verses.modern: I also learned that the portions of the Levites had not been given to them, so that the Levites and the singers who did the work had fled each to his own field.

verses.kjv: Then contended I with the rulers, and said, Why is the house of God forsaken? And I gathered them together, and set them in their place.
verses.modern: So I confronted the officials and said, "Why is the house of God forsaken?" I gathered the Levites together and restored them to their posts.

verses.kjv: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries.
verses.modern: Then all Judah brought the tithe of grain, new wine, and oil to the storehouses.

verses.kjv: And I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah: for they were counted faithful, and their office was to distribute unto their brethren.
verses.modern: I appointed as treasurers over the storehouses Shelemiah the priest, Zadok the scribe, and Pedaiah of the Levites, and alongside them Hanan the son of Zaccur, son of Mattaniah. They were considered trustworthy. It was their duty to distribute the portions to their brothers.

verses.kjv: Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for the offices thereof.
verses.modern: Remember me, O my God, for this, and do not blot out my faithful deeds that I have done for the house of my God and for its service.

verses.kjv: In those days saw I in Judah some treading wine presses on the sabbath, and bringing in sheaves, and lading asses; as also wine, grapes, and figs, and all manner of burdens, which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day: and I testified against them in the day wherein they sold victuals.
verses.modern: In those days I saw people in Judah treading winepresses on the Sabbath and bringing in grain, loading it on donkeys — as well as wine, grapes, figs, and all kinds of loads — and bringing them to Jerusalem on the Sabbath day. I warned them against selling food on that day.

verses.kjv: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein, which brought fish, and all manner of ware, and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.
verses.modern: Residents of Tyre who lived there were bringing in fish and all kinds of merchandise and selling it on the Sabbath to the people of Judah and in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said unto them, What evil thing is this that ye do, and profane the sabbath day?
verses.modern: So I confronted the nobles of Judah and said to them, "What is this evil thing you are doing, profaning the Sabbath?

verses.kjv: Did not your fathers thus, and did not our God bring all this evil upon us, and upon this city? yet ye bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath.
verses.modern: Did not your ancestors do the same things, and did not our God bring all this disaster on us and on this city? Now you are bringing more wrath on Israel by profaning the Sabbath."

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the sabbath, I commanded that the gates should be shut, and charged that they should not be opened till after the sabbath: and some of my servants set I at the gates, that there should no burden be brought in on the sabbath day.
verses.modern: When it began to grow dark at the gates of Jerusalem before the Sabbath, I commanded that the doors should be shut and not opened until after the Sabbath. I stationed some of my own servants at the gates so that no load could be brought in on the Sabbath day.

verses.kjv: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice.
verses.modern: So the merchants and sellers of all kinds of goods lodged outside Jerusalem once or twice.

verses.kjv: Then I testified against them, and said unto them, Why lodge ye about the wall? if ye do so again, I will lay hands on you. And from that time forth came they no more on the sabbath.
verses.modern: Then I warned them and said to them, "Why are you staying near the wall? If you do this again, I will arrest you." From that time on they did not come on the Sabbath.

verses.kjv: And I commanded the Levites that they should cleanse themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify the sabbath day. Remember me, O my God, concerning this also, and spare me according to the greatness of thy mercy.
verses.modern: Then I commanded the Levites to purify themselves and come and guard the gates, to keep the Sabbath day holy. Remember me for this also, O my God, and spare me according to the greatness of Your mercy.

verses.kjv: In those days also saw I Jews that had married wives of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab:
verses.modern: In those days I also saw Jews who had married women from Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab.

verses.kjv: And their children spake half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews' language, but according to the language of each people.
verses.modern: Half of their children spoke the language of Ashdod or the language of one of the other peoples, and could not speak the language of Judah.

verses.kjv: And I contended with them, and cursed them, and smote certain of them, and plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, saying, Ye shall not give your daughters unto their sons, nor take their daughters unto your sons, or for yourselves.
verses.modern: I rebuked them and called curses down on them. I beat some of them and pulled out their hair. I made them swear by God, saying, "You shall not give your daughters to their sons, nor shall you take their daughters for your sons or for yourselves.

verses.kjv: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? yet among many nations was there no king like him, who was beloved of his God, and God made him king over all Israel: nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause to sin.
verses.modern: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin in this very way? Among the many nations there was no king like him. He was loved by his God. God made him king over all Israel. Yet even He was led into sin by foreign women.

verses.kjv: Shall we then hearken unto you to do all this great evil, to transgress against our God in marrying strange wives?
verses.modern: Must we now hear that you too are doing all this great evil, being unfaithful to our God by marrying foreign women?"

verses.kjv: And one of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son in law to Sanballat the Horonite: therefore I chased him from me.
verses.modern: One of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was a son-in-law of Sanballat the Horonite. So I drove him away from me.

verses.kjv: Remember them, O my God, because they have defiled the priesthood, and the covenant of the priesthood, and of the Levites.
verses.modern: Remember them, O my God, because they have defiled the priesthood and the covenant of the priests and the Levites.

verses.kjv: Thus cleansed I them from all strangers, and appointed the wards of the priests and the Levites, every one in his business;
verses.modern: So I cleansed them from everything foreign and assigned duties to the priests and Levites, each to his own task,

verses.kjv: And for the wood offering, at times appointed, and for the firstfruits. Remember me, O my God, for good.
verses.modern: I arranged for the supply of wood at appointed times and for the firstfruits. Remember me, O my God, for good.

chapters.summary: On Nehemiah’s return from Babylon he found that Tobiah had been given a room in the temple courts, the Levites had not received their portions, the Sabbath was being profaned by merchants, and Jews had married foreign women. Nehemiah expelled Tobiah, restored the tithes, shut the gates on the Sabbath, and rebuked those who had intermarried.
